# BO - Product Page - Redirection type - Category without image generate 404 call

When you choose a category as the redirection type when the product is disabled, the category listing also displays an image even if it's not administered, and this generates a 404.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7e28ecd5-db6a-43db-aefb-d8fe4d16a301)

## Attendu
Display no image if category has no image or no image at all at this location

## Étapes
1. Go to category A and delete default image
2. Go to product page
2. Select a category redirection type when the product is deactivated
3. Search category A and see the category A with broken image before
